---
name: Improvement proposal
about: Propose a focused improvement with an evidenced contract
---

### Problem and intended benefit

Affected existing tools, current behavior and intended output.

### Existing functionality

What is already covered? Why is an integration change or new capability justified?

### Proposed contract

Documented cmdlet/API, source control plane, official reference and exact version/build evidence or explicit uncertainty. No invented endpoints.

### Reproducible example

Fabricated input and expected output. Separate missing information from a verified observation or verdict.

### Safety, provenance and validation

Read-only scope, explicit connection boundary, source/rights evidence and meaningful offline tests. Do not attach corporate or third-party code without verified redistribution rights. Do not change the pending project license.
